name: Skyworks Solutions
key_signal: Despite a golden cross, SWKS trades below its 200-day moving average and has fallen ~34% from its 52-week high on a -44.9% earnings growth print and flat/negative revenue growth.
thesis: The stock's forward P/E of 11.7 (vs trailing 25) implies the market expects a sharp earnings rebound, and the 4.79% dividend yield offers income support while low leverage (debt/equity ~20.6%) gives balance-sheet flexibility to wait out the cycle. Gross margins remain healthy at 41%, suggesting the core mix business isn't structurally impaired, and a golden cross (50dma above 200dma) is a textbook bullish technical setup that could attract trend-followers if momentum stabilizes.
bear_case: Momentum is actively deteriorating (mom_21d -13.2%, MACD histogram negative, RSI just below 41) and the stock sits below its 200-day average despite the golden cross, which is a lagging indicator likely to reverse if the downtrend persists; more importantly, earnings growth is down nearly 45% with revenue growth still negative, ROE is a weak 6.2%, and profit margins are thin at ~8.9%, meaning the 'cheap' forward P/E assumes an earnings recovery that isn't yet visible in the trailing fundamentals — a classic value trap where the 4.79% yield could be cut if free cash flow ($688M against a $9B cap) doesn't improve, and 16 analysts already rate it 'hold,' implying limited near-term re-rating catalyst from coverage initiation or upgrades.
